description: The PI's live line-up (ADR-0051, ADR-0052). WHERE RESPONDENT TEXT GOES: to Anthropic (Claude Opus 5.5 on coder A, the judge, the refactorer and the Definer, which reuses the refactorer slot) and to the hosted Qwen endpoint named by GAF_COMPAT_BASE_URL (coder B). Embeddings stay on this machine (Ollama embeddinggemma, 768-d). Needs the PI's confirmation of both data processors before any run on real survey data. CONFIRM ON THE DAY: coder B's model id string for the chosen host ('qwen3.8-max' on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; OpenRouter ids carry a 'qwen/' prefix) and its two rates. Effort: coder A medium, judge low, refactorer high; max_output_tokens leaves room for thinking, which is billed as output. Keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GAF_COMPAT_BASE_URL, GAF_COMPAT_API_KEY. Pull first: ollama pull embeddinggemma

priced_from.anthropic: claude-opus-5-5 at $4 in / $20 out per million tokens: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-10-04
priced_from.openai_compatible: qwen3.8-max at about $2 in / $6 out per million tokens: third-party pages, introductory pricing, NOT yet verified on the host's own price page; re-read it on the day and edit both rates if they differ
